connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source:
The **Store Hash** is required to connect to your BigCommerce store.

**How to find it:**
1. Log in to your BigCommerce admin panel
2. Look at the URL: `https://store-**XXXXX**.mybigcommerce.com`
3. The store hash is the `XXXXX` part after `store-`

**Alternative:** Go to **Settings > API Accounts** and check the **API Path**, e.g., `https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/**XXXXX**/v3`
connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message:
連接到您的 BigCommerce 商店需要 **Store Hash**。

**如何查找：**
1. 登入您的 BigCommerce 管理介面
2. 查看網址：`https://store-**XXXXX**.mybigcommerce.com`
3. Store hash 是 `XXXXX` 後面的 `store-` 部分

**其他方式：** 前往 **設定 > API 帳戶**，檢查 **API 路徑**，例如 `https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/**XXXXX**/v3`

connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: How to Find Your Store Hash
connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: 如何查找您的 Store Hash

connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..source: The store hash identifying your BigCommerce store. You can find it in the BigCommerce admin under Settings > API Accounts > API Path (e.g., https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/<store_hash>/v3)
connection.QmlnQ29tbWVyY2VSZXN0Q2xpZW50..message: 識別您 BigCommerce 商店的 store hash。您可在 BigCommerce 管理介面的 **設定 > API 帳戶 > API 路徑** 中找到（例如 https://api.bigcommerce.com/stores/<store_hash>/v3 ）
